collection.title: Audi TT 2006 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Audi TT 2006 to 2014 model requires a 22" wiper blade for the drivers and a 21" for the passengers side with a Pinch Tab arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
